items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I don't think Cottrell lies. I don't think Cottrell lies.

ctx.x: Cause just let's get right in. You ain't no lie, sure. Ain't nothing happening right now, first week.
I don't think Cottrell lies. I don't think Cottrell lies.
No, he wouldn't have said that. If I'd have been playing there, I'd have told him, I'd have said, let me look, let Bob play.
